decision_rationale: This is presented as a new multimodal LLM, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It explicitly connects transcriptomic profiles with natural-language biological tasks and uses free-text biological knowledge and QA data.
evidence_snippet: "We introduce OmicsLM, a multimodal LLM that connects quantitative omics profiles with natural-language biological tasks"; "combining continuous transcriptomic inputs... and free-text biological knowledge and question-answering data"; "natural-language instructions".
